name: Frontiers of the Roman Empire – Dacia
description: Across Romania, this chain of 277 sites traces the edge of Roman Dacia, the only Roman province lying entirely north of the Danube. Between 106 and 271 CE, legionary fortresses, smaller forts, earthen ramparts, watchtowers and temporary camps guarded the province's gold and salt. Today you can wander grassy banks and ruined walls across very varied landscapes.
